purpose: Preserve all 61 primary fixed-probe vector arrays with their source-derived small publication closure in an immutable content-addressed dataset prefix; never treat durability as scientific completion.

archive_contract.authoring_gate: Full checkpoint-backed publication audit before remote work; repeat portable/statistical and raw-vector identity checks when constructing and verifying the archive.
archive_contract.payload_selection: Exact source-derived portable closure, 61 canonical raw vector arrays, and explicitly named reconstruction implementation/configuration files. No recursive whole-repository upload.
archive_contract.addressing: SHA-256 of the canonical archive_manifest.json bytes determines a new prefix. Never overwrite conflicting contents.
archive_contract.upload: Stage private temporary copies; hash them against frozen identities; atomically create additions against an immutable parent commit; no remote deletion or visibility change.
archive_contract.verification: Compare exact paths, sizes and LFS SHA-256 / Git-blob SHA-1 at the returned immutable commit, not mutable main.
archive_contract.recovery: A lost receipt may adopt a fully matching immutable remote snapshot and labels it recovered_verified_snapshot, not an original upload commit.
archive_contract.audit: Rechecks the original receipt commit even if remote main advances. Keeps the original first_verified_at_utc and provenance.
archive_contract.offline_download: Require the trusted receipt manifest SHA-256, exact file set and all file digests; no producer directory or network fallback.

operational_boundary: CPU/network only; preserve active training and backup source contracts. Deploy only through the zero-step handoff after exact main completion.

raw_feature_replay.input: Verified downloaded archive and manifest SHA-256 from the trusted immutable-commit receipt
raw_feature_replay.output: A new directory outside the immutable archive; no overwritten inputs
raw_feature_replay.covariance_ablation_random_masks_rotatio: Reuse the exact numerical kernel used by authoring; recompute all 61 states and compare all output cells and attribution arrays

dependency_amendment: The archive/replay use a lightweight file-inventory module instead of importing the live checkpoint-backup stack. Those training/backup implementations remain unchanged.

visualization_amendment.description: The source-bound publisher now renders the frozen all-rate random-removal and utility trajectories as native vector LaTeX, with all 68 plotted means in a recomputed CSV. Existing closure selection archives the exact figure source and values. No new inference or controller command.
